purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0038 in the quantum arena: the Tsirelson bound 2 root 2 follows from anticommutation in any qubit theory (Tsirelson 1980, Landau 1987), commuting structure gives only the classical bound 2, and the {3,4,3,4} coin quaternion units provide an anticommuting pair, so the quantum maximum is available to the coin without tuning.
